_notes: Ground objects placed on the map (LDtk entities). Editable live in the tuning panel (press T).
hp: hit points (infantry: per soldier). points: score for destroying it (infantry: per soldier). width, height: size in world units, also the hit box.
bulletFactor: share of bullet damage it takes (bombs always do full damage). solid: planes that fly into it crash. spacing: gap between soldiers in a squad.
Shooting. range: how far it can reach a plane. turnRate: how fast the barrel swings (rad/s). spread: random aim error (rad). velocity: muzzle speed. damage: per round.

Flak: interval between shots; minAltitude: planes lower than this above the ground are ignored (fly low to dodge); minElevation: lowest the barrel can point (rad); fuseError: share the time fuse is off by; burstRadius, burstDamage (at the centre), fireChance (at the centre) of each shell burst.
MG nest: burst and pause: seconds firing and resting; rpm while firing. Infantry: each soldier fires once every interval seconds, give or take half.

Moving units (tanks, infantry and engineers sent out in waves): speed in world units per second; gap: clear space kept behind the unit ahead; engageRange: an enemy this close ahead stops them to fight.

Tank: armour takes bulletFactor of bullet damage from the front and sides, roofFactor from steep dives. Main gun (ground targets only): gunRange, gunInterval, gunVelocity, shellRadius and shellDamage of each shell. The coaxial MG uses range, mgAltitude (only planes lower than this), turnRate, burst, pause, rpm, velocity, damage, spread. wreckBlock: seconds a knocked-out tank blocks the way.

Decor (decor: true) is placed from the map's zones, not in LDtk, and belongs to nobody: tanks and gunners ignore it. obstacle: hedge (a plane on or skimming the ground ploughs through, losing speed and some hit points) or wall (tears the gear off: a belly landing). Trees and barns are solid.

Truck: carries one squad (seats men at most) from the depot to the front. sprites: which truck each nation drives. It stops and the men climb out over the tailgate, one every dismountTime seconds, when an enemy is within dismountRange ahead, after holdDismount seconds stuck behind its column, or below hurtDismount of its hit points; then it drives home. Knocked out with men aboard, each dies with passengerLoss, the rest jump clear. An open truck (waves.openTrucks) shows its men: a bullet striking it hits one of them with openHit times the share of seats taken. Blasts hurt the men aboard fully in an open truck, tarpShield of it under a tarp.

Bridge: bombs only (bulletFactor 0); rebuildTime: seconds a full squad of engineers needs to rebuild it from nothing. Hangar: as it's damaged the ground crew work slower; destroyed, they can't work at all.
